title: Chat view and ConversationService integration
description:
Goal
- Implement the primary chat interface powered by ConversationService flows and history.

Startup
- Call latestConversation. If present, call startFlow with the last flow.id; otherwise call startFlow with 'start' to initialize a new flow.

Rendering logic
- Render each ConversationFlowModel.message (HTML) in order, respecting nextDelay between items for a paced display.
- When reaching the end of the current batch:
  - If last item.type is 'Input': render inputs per inputsData; on submit call handleInput or handleFileInput; then continue rendering returned flow items with delays.
  - If last item.type is 'Process': show a processing indicator message, call handleProcess, then continue rendering returned flow items with delays.
  - Else: no more items; mark conversation finished and disable user input.

Input UI rules
- TEXT, NUMERIC, DATE, WEIGHT_HEIGHT: single bottom input box (only one of these at a time). If AUDIO is also present, show a record button next to the text input.
- BUTTONS: render button groups below the message using the provided 2D layout.
- MULTI_SELECTION: render checkboxes below the message with a submit action to send selected values.
- AUDIO: if no text input present, render a centered record button; if combined with text, place the record button inline with the text input.

History
- Use getHistory to fetch and display older messages above the current flow.

Tech notes
- Sanitize or trust server-provided HTML per backend contract; consider a safe HTML renderer.
- Manage timers for nextDelay via a scheduler to avoid unmounted updates.
- Integrate with React Query for data fetching and mutations.

Acceptance criteria
- Correctly resumes or starts a conversation via latestConversation and startFlow.
- Sequential message display respects nextDelay and renders message HTML.
- Proper handling for Input and Process steps; input disabled when conversation is finished.
- History loads and displays above current messages; errors show toasts or inline messages.

features.title: Conversation service module
features.description: Create a thin module that re-exports and centralizes calls to ConversationService endpoints (latestConversation, startFlow, handleInput, handleFileInput, handleProcess, getHistory) for clarity. Do not wrap OpenAPI client; import services directly from '@/generated/backend'. Ensure functions are typed and align with generated models.

features.title: Flow sequencer and scheduler
features.description: Implement a state machine and scheduler to render ConversationFlowModel items in order, respecting 'nextDelay'. Support cancelation on unmount and recovery when new batches arrive after inputs/process steps. Acceptance: messages appear with correct pacing; timers are cleaned up.

features.title: Message renderer (HTML-safe)
features.description: Render 'ConversationFlowModel.message' HTML safely. For MVP, use 'dangerouslySetInnerHTML' with strict constraints (container styles, no inline scripts) and document trust boundary. Optionally add a sanitizer if required. Acceptance: messages render without breaking layout.

features.title: Input widgets - single value types
features.description: Provide a bottom input for TEXT, NUMERIC, DATE, WEIGHT_HEIGHT types. Validate and submit via 'handleInput'; on success, append returned flow items and continue sequencing. If AUDIO is also present, render a record button inline next to the text input.

features.title: Buttons grid renderer
features.description: Render BUTTONS input as a 2D matrix of button groups under the corresponding message. Click submits selected value via 'handleInput' and triggers the next flow batch with delays.

features.title: Multi-selection input
features.description: Render MULTI_SELECTION as a checkbox group with a submit action to send selected values via 'handleInput'. Preserve selections until submitted; allow clearing. Acceptance: multiple selections send correctly and advance flow.

features.title: Audio input and upload
features.description: Provide recording UX. If combined with text input, show record button inline; if alone, center it. On stop, upload blob via 'handleFileInput' and continue the flow. Show upload progress and basic error handling.

features.title: Process step handler
features.description: When last flow item is of type 'Process', show a processing indicator/message and call 'handleProcess'. After completion, render returned flow items with delays. Acceptance: processing state visible; next items appear correctly.

features.title: History loader
features.description: Use 'getHistory' to load and prepend earlier messages. Provide a 'Load previous' control at the top of the chat area, merging without duplicates and keeping scroll position reasonable.

features.title: Conversation completion state
features.description: Detect when the conversation ends (no Input or Process at end) and disable input controls. Show a final state message or CTA to start a new conversation if applicable.

features.title: Error and retry for chat actions
features.description: For each API action (startFlow, handleInput, handleFileInput, handleProcess, getHistory), display inline error and offer retry. Ensure the flow state remains consistent and idempotent where possible.

features.title: Render only non-empty messages and remove completion banner
features.description:
Fix chat rendering and unintended finish UI.
- Filter out sequencer items with empty or whitespace-only 'message' so blank cards are never shown.
- Remove the 'Conversation finished' banner and 'Start new' CTA entirely (not part of spec).
- Treat 'messageRequiresProcessing' as a processing state to auto-continue via 'handleProcess' when needed.
Acceptance criteria:
- No blank messages render in the chat.
- The finish banner/CTA is never displayed.
- Process-type or messageRequiresProcessing items auto-advance and display returned messages.

features.title: Modularize ChatView presentation components
features.description:
Refactor ChatView into smaller, maintainable components without changing behavior.
- Extract to 'src/app/chat/components': ChatItem (or MessageList), HistoryHeader (load previous / retry), Error banners (start/process/input), SingleInputBar, AudioInputBar, ButtonsGrid.
- Wire props to keep state in ChatView; ensure type-safety and reuse.
Acceptance criteria:
- ChatView imports these components; no behavior or UX changes.
- Code is easier to inspect/modify; components are self-contained and documented with props.
